nameEn: Manufacture of other pumps, compressors, taps and valves
description: This class includes the manufacture of pumps for liquids, gas compressors, and industrial taps and valves.
includes: manufacture of pumps for liquids: centrifugal pumps, reciprocating positive displacement pumps, rotary positive displacement pumps
manufacture of air pumps, vacuum pumps and air or gas compressors
manufacture of refrigerating and air conditioning compressors
manufacture of industrial taps and valves: pressure-reducing valves, process control valves, check valves, safety relief valves
manufacture of pipeline equipment: industrial pipe fittings, valves
manufacture of water meters, gas meters and similar meters
excludes: manufacture of fluid power equipment, see 2812
manufacture of valves made of rubber, see 2219
manufacture of valves made of glass, see 2310
manufacture of domestic gas appliances, see 2750
manufacture of taps and fittings of plastic, see 2220
